# Purchasing workstation

Current job records are in /workspace/current. Business records are in /workspace/records. Use `purchasing --help` for purchase placement and status. Working files are under /workspace. The project registry at /registry retains files between jobs.

---FILES---
approval.json	/workspace/current/approval.json
budget.json	/workspace/current/budget.json
contract.json	/workspace/current/contract.json
customer.txt	/workspace/current/customer.txt
quote.json	/workspace/current/quote.json
requisition.json	/workspace/current/requisition.json

command:
for f in /workspace/current/*; do echo "--- $f"; if [[ "$f" == *.json ]]; then python -m json.tool "$f"; else cat "$f"; fi; done
printf '\n--- purchasing help ---\n'; purchasing --help
